from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib, re
blob = subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:.pre-commit-config.yaml"], text=True)
parent = subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD^:.pre-commit-config.yaml"], text=True)
# extract hook-level exclude blocks that immediately follow mutating fixer ids
ids = ["end-of-file-fixer", "trailing-whitespace", "mixed-line-ending"]
def extract_hook_excludes(text):
    out = {}
    for hid in ids:
        m = re.search(rf"- id: {re.escape(hid)}\n(?P<body>.*?)(?=\n      - id: |\n\n  # |\Z)", text, re.S)
        out[hid] = m.group("body") if m else None
    return out
head_h = extract_hook_excludes(blob)
par_h = extract_hook_excludes(parent)
print("=== HEAD_HOOK_EXCLUDE_PRESENT ===")
for hid in ids:
    body = head_h[hid] or ""
    has = "exclude: |" in body
    print(f"{hid}: HAS_EXCLUDE={has}")
    paths = re.findall(r"forensic/[^\n|]+", body)
    print(f"{hid}: PATH_COUNT={len(paths)}")
    for p in paths:
        print(f"  PATH={p.replace(chr(92),\"\")}")
print("=== PARENT_HOOK_EXCLUDE_PRESENT ===")
for hid in ids:
    body = par_h[hid] or ""
    print(f"{hid}: HAS_EXCLUDE={\"exclude: |\" in body}")
# compare three HEAD exclude regex blocks
blocks = re.findall(r"- id: (end-of-file-fixer|trailing-whitespace|mixed-line-ending)\n(?:.*\n)*?        exclude: \|\n(?P<ex>(?:          .*\n)+)", blob)
print("=== RAW_EXCLUDE_BLOCKS ===")
excludes = []
for m in re.finditer(r"- id: (end-of-file-fixer|trailing-whitespace|mixed-line-ending)\n(?:        args: .*\n)?        exclude: \|\n((?:          .*\n)+)", blob):
    print("---HOOK---", m.group(1))
    print(m.group(2), end="")
    excludes.append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
print("=== EXCLUDE_BLOCK_EQUALITY ===")
print("COUNT=", len(excludes))
if excludes:
    first = excludes[0][1]
    for hid, ex in excludes:
        print(f"{hid}_EQUALS_FIRST={ex==first} SHA256={hashlib.sha256(ex.encode()).hexdigest()}")
print("=== OTHER_NEW_EXCLUDES_IN_DIFF ===")
diff = subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD^","HEAD","--",".pre-commit-config.yaml"], text=True)
added_ids = re.findall(r"^\+      - id: (.+)$", diff, re.M)
print("ADDED_HOOK_IDS=", added_ids)
print("ADDED_EXCLUDE_MARKERS=", len(re.findall(r"^\+        exclude: \|", diff, re.M)))
print("PARENT_SIZE_GATE=", "check-added-large-files" in parent and "[--maxkb=1024]" in parent)
print("HEAD_SIZE_GATE=", "check-added-large-files" in blob and "[--maxkb=1024]" in blob)
print("SIZE_GATE_LINE_IN_DIFF=", "check-added-large-files" in diff or "maxkb" in diff)
'
